title: Upgrade to business
statementMd:
Upgrade all economy bookings on flight 1 to `business` and then list the seat class counts for flight 1.

Expected columns: `seat_class`, `n`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
UPDATE bookings SET seat_class = 'business' WHERE flight_id = 1 AND seat_class = 'economy'; SELECT seat_class, COUNT(*) AS n FROM bookings WHERE flight_id = 1 GROUP BY seat_class;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
